prompt: A hulking ogre with coarse slate-gray hide and slabs of muscle, hunched and roaring with mouth agape and yellow tusks bared, hefting a crude knotted tree-trunk club overhead in both fists. Tattered leather straps and a stained loincloth, knuckles scarred. He looms at the center of the frame, lit from below by an off-frame campfire whose warm orange glow rims his gray shoulders against the dark. The background is a dim rocky cave mouth with embers drifting and a smoke-blackened ceiling.

A heavy ogre with coarse slate-gray skin trudging in side profile facing west across a smoldering battlefield at dusk, shoulders hunched forward, one long arm dragging a crude club studded with iron spikes that scrapes the ground. Sagging gut, broad flat face with a heavy brow and small mean eyes, ragged hide kilt. The background is a charred plain with low orange embers and drifting ash under a dark wine-purple twilight sky.
